name: dupes
description:
Duplicates of the phrases, by kind.

action: mark_except_first (true for each duplicate, false for the first of its group), mark_all (true for every member of a group of 2 or more), drop (keep the first, drop the rest).

Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" --text "диван купить" --text "кресло" dupes lemmas --action mark_except_first write -
-> купить диван, false; диван купить, true; кресло, false
Example: semkit read --text "купить диван" --text "диван купить" --text "кресло" dupes implicit --action drop write -
-> купить диван; кресло

kind: exact (the same text), explicit (the same in any case, with ё as е and any spaces), implicit (the same words in another order), lemmas (the same lemmas in any order) or meaning (close phrase vectors, and the words that differ are only non-refining words, synonyms or the home city).
neutral: the Human's non-refining words for --kind meaning, as @FILE or @NAME of a list; they add to the bundled list @meaning/neutral. Words are compared by lemma.
synonyms: a file with the columns word and synonyms, as the step `synonyms` gives, for --kind meaning; a word and its synonyms are the same word. The file is read like `read` does.
home: the name of the home city for --kind meaning; its word is non-refining, another city's is not.
threshold: the similarity from 0 to 1 two phrases need to be one intent, for --kind meaning. Without it the threshold of the model.
model: the encoder, pulled once with `semkit models pull NAME`: e5-small, bge-m3, potion, or hf:<id> of a model of the Hugging Face hub. Without --threshold the step takes the threshold of the model; a hub model has none.

The step marks the duplicates of the working column in a new column <column>_dupes; with --action drop it keeps only the first row of each group. With --kind meaning it also adds the columns dupe_of (the first row of the group, the phrase kept) and similarity (the cosine to it) next to it.

options.description: exact (the same text), explicit (the same in any case, with ё as е and any spaces), implicit (the same words in another order), lemmas (the same lemmas in any order) or meaning (close phrase vectors, and the words that differ are only non-refining words, synonyms or the home city).

options.description: the encoder, pulled once with `semkit models pull NAME`: e5-small, bge-m3, potion, or hf:<id> of a model of the Hugging Face hub. Without --threshold the step takes the threshold of the model; a hub model has none.

options.description: the Human's non-refining words for --kind meaning, as @FILE or @NAME of a list; they add to the bundled list @meaning/neutral. Words are compared by lemma. Items: a comma list 'a,b', @FILE (one item per line, or the first column of a table) or @NAME of a list.

options.name: --synonyms
options.description: a file with the columns word and synonyms, as the step `synonyms` gives, for --kind meaning; a word and its synonyms are the same word. The file is read like `read` does.

options.name: --home
options.description: the name of the home city for --kind meaning; its word is non-refining, another city's is not.

options.name: --as
options.description: Write the result to a new column NAME and keep the working column as it is.
